description: Request frame blending on a clip through QE DOM. Premiere exposes no frame-blend readback, so the result is committed_unverified and must be checked in Effect Controls.

enabled.description: True to enable frame blending, false to disable

name: set_frame_blend

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Set Frame Blend
